authority.own_null_precedent: docs/results/2026-09-22-slurp-planr-v2-lock-replicate-verdict.md (TRAIN Fold A) and the DEV-2000-ADDED own null of the CELL-3 package

cell_kind: CONSTRUCTION-VARIANT ROLLOUT. The deliverable is a per-variant table and a group-relative advantage table, not a verdict.
claim_boundary: Descriptive paired read on a CONSTRUCTION roster (split role discovery). No admission, no lock, no store release, no test claim, no superiority or generalisation claim. Owner decisions 28 / 86 / 29 / 108. A variant that separates from the null here is a CANDIDATE for an out-of-fold re-read on TRAIN Fold A and DEV-2000-ADDED, each at that roster's own null.

decision_rule.rule: see protocol-registered-v1.json decision_rule. The family returns a table; no ADMITTED / NEUTRAL / HARMFUL label is attached to any VAR-1 cell.

delta_convention: delta = variant minus VAR1-PLAN, in percentage points; negative is worse
diagnostics_required: THE VARIANT TABLE, the item this family exists for: for each of the four variants and for VAR1-PLANR, the paired delta against VAR1-PLAN on official pooled SLU-F1 and intent, with CI90, CI95, saves / harms / ties and the exact McNemar sign-test p, beside h_SLU and h_intent from the own null.

GROUP-RELATIVE ADVANTAGE PER RUNTIME-OBSERVABLE STATE: for each state key (predicted majority candidate scenario, candidate count, channel, audio-duration band), each variant's per-row score minus the per-row mean over the variants, aggregated, with the per-state n. Never read as an effect below n = 20.

GOLD PER-SCENARIO TABLES per variant, in both the natural mixture and the equal-stratum weighting, over the 18 R01C strata (26-42 rows each) from the roster receipt's per-item stratum. This is available here and was NOT available on DEV-2000-ADDED.

ENTITY FP / FN BY SLOT TYPE per variant, with the empty-gold-row emission rate: the bad-case classes the exemplar knobs are aimed at (entity FN about 31.5 %, date omission dominant; entity FP about 28.8 %, 184 of 414 empty-gold rows emitting).

PERCEPTION COVERAGE per variant from the sealed Perception receipts, model-free: the rate at which the gold intent appears in the row's own projected candidate list, the candidate count distribution, and the distinctness of the candidate ids. This is the quantity VAR1-PER-K16C5 exists to move; reading it from the pooled score instead would be reading a 2 pp lever through a 1.3 pp floor.

SUPPLY REALISATION per variant: the realised number of exemplar values supplied per row (the EX knobs) and of intent cards seeded per row (the PER knob), from the flight's own phase-supply receipts, beside the offline dry-run projection. VAR1-EX-DIV in particular has a DATA-DEPENDENT supply size -- c = 4 per intent target caps a concentrated neighbourhood and leaves a diverse one untouched -- and the realised distribution is a finding.
PER-CHANNEL table (67 headset, 558 far-field) from the roster's own headset field, descriptive and unclustered.

COST per variant: contacts, contacts per row, prefilled and cached tokens per row, GPU hours per 625 rows, and the frontier row. VAR1-EX-K10 is expected to be cheaper than VAR1-PLAN and VAR1-EX-K30 / VAR1-PER-K16C5 dearer; the exchange rate between tokens and score is part of what a construction rollout measures.

E20 COMPACTION per phase and per variant: rows compacted, at which phase and by how much. Zero is expected on VAR1-PLAN / PLANR / EX-K10 / EX-DIV; a non-zero count on VAR1-EX-K30 or VAR1-PER-K16C5 is a caveat on that variant's token basis and is reported, not hidden. An ABSTENTION caused by compaction is a failure, not a caveat.

DISPOSITIONS per variant: finite_completion rows (item E13), react_exhaustion rows (item E22), planner illegal-action rows, parse failures, and the delivery-normaliser receipt count. A variant whose disposition profile differs from VAR1-PLAN's has changed the episode's behaviour and not only its supply.

driver.status_written: DESCRIPTIVE, always. This family has no verdict for the coordinator to apply.

open_items.item: scripts/analysis/slurp_paired_roster_read.py produces the pooled paired contrast, the per-channel table, the structural counts and the efficiency block on this roster, and nothing else. It hard-codes 'per-scenario NOT AVAILABLE' for its own roster and takes no --stratum-key, so the GOLD per-scenario table -- which IS derivable on R01C -- does not come out of it as committed.
open_items.resolution: Either teach that driver a --stratum-key flag (roster-generic, with its own unit tests), or write the VAR-1 variant driver scripts/analysis/slurp_var1_variant_read.py. Either is a separate engineering change with its own review. It must land BEFORE the variant reads and NEVER beside a live flight.

open_items.item: The entity FP/FN-by-slot-type decomposition, the Perception coverage read and the group-relative advantage table have no committed driver at all. The first exists inside scripts/analysis/slurp_cell3_fresh_roster_loss_diagnostic.py bound to that cell's runs; the second and third are new.
open_items.resolution: They belong in the VAR-1 variant driver of VAR1-OPEN-1, which reads only sealed bytes (per-sample official scores, sealed outputs, sealed phase summaries, the roster receipt) and prints labels, slot TYPE names, ids, counts and hashes only -- never an utterance, a transcript, a delivered filler or a gold string.

open_items.item: The prompt-fit bound of VAR1-EX-K30 and VAR1-PER-K16C5 is NOT measured in this registration; no tokenizer was contacted.
open_items.resolution: core.flight.cli check measures it in the coordinator's clean-tree cycle. The registered expectation and the fail-closed fallback are in this document's prompt_fit block: a COMPACT_REQUIRED is expected and proceeds; a REFUSE on VAR1-EX-K30 means that cell does not open and is re-registered at k = 26 with its own new run, attempt and fit identities.

output.harm_rule: no utterance text, gold label, delivered filler or model output is printed or persisted; labels, slot TYPE names, ids, counts, rates and hashes only

own_null.order: READ FIRST. h_SLU and h_intent are sealed before any variant contrast stage is read and are never adjusted afterwards.

population.gold_per_scenario_table: AVAILABLE from the roster receipt's per-item stratum -- 18 strata, 26-42 rows each -- with no gold at runtime.

resampling.interval_form: percentile pairs of the same retained replicate sequence
tables: equal-stratum weighting over the gold scenario

scorer.runs: once per complete manifest through core.scoring_batch, never sharded; this read invokes no scorer

tables_required: THE VARIANT TABLE: one row per variant (EX-K10, EX-K30, EX-DIV, PER-K16C5) plus PLANR as the A/A control row, columns = official pooled SLU-F1, delta, CI90, CI95, intent, intent delta, CI95, saves / harms / ties, McNemar p, with h_SLU and h_intent printed in the header
the own-null margin table (VAR1-PLAN vs VAR1-PLANR), printed above the variant table and dated before it
the GOLD per-scenario table per variant in both weightings
entity FP / FN by slot TYPE per variant, with the empty-gold emission rate
Perception coverage per variant: gold-intent-in-candidates rate and the candidate count distribution
the group-relative advantage table per runtime-observable state, with per-state n
the cost and frontier table per variant, per 625 rows
the supply-realisation table per variant (exemplar values per row, intent cards per row) beside the offline dry-run projection
